rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_steps=16, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=20, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-7 NFE lever (fd_recon_steps 8->16) from best config, fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained breast val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: CG SATURATED -- iter-5(n_cg20) PSNR28.91/SSIM0.905/RMSE0.0122 is the best; iter-6(n_cg60) REGRESSED to 28.71/0.854 (extra CG over-fits noisy sparse sino, amplifies noise). Best-so-far still ~7.4 dB below the 128-view sparse-FBP floor (36.32/0.0052), hr=0 throughout. (2) Failure mode: 4 axes mapped (dc_relax0.5/1.0, init_t0.7/0.4/0.2, n_cg5/20/60) -- prior-influence and DC-strength both exhausted; the 8 discrete DC injections cap RMSE. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_steps 8->16 (2x Euler steps = 2x DC injections along the trajectory, finer data-consistency integration), from best config (n_cg20, init_t0.4, relax1.0). (4) HYPOTHESIS: more steps = more DC re-projections onto the measured sino, so PSNR/RMSE improve toward the FBP floor (the mayo sibling saw +1.67 dB/NFE-doubling); if it clears the gap, hr>0. If PSNR stays ~29 dB, the sampler axes are exhausted and the WDM-Mayo prior is genuinely below-baseline on sparse breast -> honest finding, begin confirmation toward iter-20. (5) BUDGET: iter-5 was 144s at NFE8; 2x steps ~5 min, inside 20-min. (6) Loop continues; iter-8 on landing.
